title: Office Hours at Startup School 2013 with Paul Graham and Sam Altman
summary: A Startup School 2013 session where Paul Graham and Sam Altman hold live office hours with startups including CodeCombat, Flexport and others. The founders pitch and get on-the-spot feedback.
why: HN points to it as a look at what YC office hours are like and as an early glimpse of Flexport and CodeCombat pitching.

quote.text: you can watch office hour sessions on youtube from the Startup School that YC runs
